title: E2E Assertion Integrity, Interactive Config Tests & Reproducible Acceptance Closure

blockingIssuesRemediated.B1: S18 executes real runtime disposer and reload idempotence (CONTROLLED_INTEGRATION), verifying slot unregistration, event listener removal, store disposal, and zero timer leak.
blockingIssuesRemediated.B2: S20 asserts canInstall=false, canRemove=false, verifies disabled buttons in React UI, verifies code-level bypass returns 409 DIRECTORY_QUARANTINED, and tests recovery re-sync (CONTROLLED_INJECTION).
blockingIssuesRemediated.B3: S06 validates complete cancellation state transition: running -> cancel POST with operationId -> cancelling response -> no false install success -> cancelled status -> settled UI (CONTROLLED_INJECTION).
blockingIssuesRemediated.B4: S10 validates UI rapid double click on "一键安装 ECDICT", records outgoing POSTs, verifies button disabled state, and validates Host mutex 409 with concurrent POST (REAL).
blockingIssuesRemediated.B5: P2 interactive tests in client-settings-ui.spec.ts now actively trigger switch toggle events, test out-of-order resolution, and test unmounted component async settlement with 0 unhandled rejections.
blockingIssuesRemediated.B6: S17 verifies light vs dark theme computed styles (color, backgroundColor), captures distinct screenshots with different SHA-256 hashes, and tests 520px narrow responsiveness without overflow.
blockingIssuesRemediated.B7: Commit code and test runner first, freeze TESTED_CODE_SHA, run full test suites on that exact SHA, and produce evidence in a strict evidence-only commit.
blockingIssuesRemediated.B8: Explained full regression suite test discovery: 49 test files / 869 tests across the repository, where the previous 13/218 was a filtered run during settings development.

S01.name: Settings "词典" Entry Registration
S01.precondition: Clean DSH profile booted with dsh-word-lookup bundle registered
S01.action: Open Settings dialog and inspect navigation items

S02.name: Initial Fixture State with Truthful Counts

S16.name: Gesture Switches via ConfigForms
S16.precondition: Settings page open with gesture switches rendered
S16.action: Click switch buttons and verify reactive DOM state & host TriggerGate synchronization
assertions: TriggerGate reflects updated switches in real time

S04.name: Downloading Phase Streaming Progress Verification
S04.precondition: Settings page open, status mocked with downloading progress (45%)
S04.action: Observe ProgressBar, aria attributes, cancellation button and byte metrics rendered by React
assertions: Displays "29.7 MB / 65.9 MB" and processed bytes

S06.name: Cancellation Flow Verification
S06.action: Click "取消安装", verify POST /cancel with operationId, verify cancelling response, transition status to cancelled, observe settled UI
assertions: Cancel button enabled when canCancel: true
UI does not fabricate premature completed state

S07.name: Non-Cancellable Commit Boundary Verification
S07.precondition: Operation in atomic activation commit phase (canCancel: false)
S07.action: Verify disabled button attribute, explanatory note, and 409 API response
assertions: Button disabled with label "不可取消 (提交中)"

S09.name: Component Failure Presentation Truthfulness
S09.precondition: Host reports settled failed operation with retryable error
S09.action: Observe React component DictionarySettingsSection rendering alert element without manual DOM tampering

observed.alertText: 最近一次操作失败: 下载词源超时，请检查网络连接 (可点击安装重试)

assertions: Displays sanitized message and retry prompt

S03.name: 1-Click Install Request Acceptance
assertions: Host accepts task and assigns operationId

S10.name: Duplicate Install Concurrency Guard & UI Rapid Click
S10.action: Playwright rapid double click on "一键安装 ECDICT", then issue parallel POST /dictionary/install request
assertions: UI button click dispatches exactly one task without duplicate race
Concurrent parallel request refused by Host with HTTP 409
Exactly one operationId active on Host

S11.name: Concurrent Removal Refusal
assertions: Removal blocked while operation in progress

S05.name: SQLite Construction & Integrity Validation Phase
S05.precondition: ECDICT CSV source pre-seeded; install operation initiated
S05.action: Poll status during SQLite build and PRAGMA integrity_check

S08.name: Full ECDICT Activation & Live Query Hit
S08.precondition: ECDICT installation and database activation completed
S08.action: Verify status UI counts, badge, and issue live lookup for "apple"
assertions: Displays "770,611 词条" and "57,689 记录"

S17.name: Visual Themes (Dark, Light, Narrow) QA
S17.precondition: Settings page open with full ECDICT active
S17.action: Toggle data-theme dark/light and resize viewport to 520px
assertions: Dark theme rendered with dark tokens
Light theme rendered with distinct light background and text styles
Light and dark screenshots have unique SHA-256 hashes (no duplicate blobs)
Narrow 520px viewport wraps without horizontal overflow

S13.name: Close & Reopen Settings Page
S13.action: Close settings modal via Escape, reopen via shortcut, verify clean store lifecycle & single timer ownership
assertions: Active ECDICT status retained upon reopening
Store lifecycle cleanly handles close and reopen
Single active timer loop owned at any time (zero duplicate polling timers)

S14.name: Browser Refresh Persistence
S14.action: Execute browser page.reload() and reopen settings
assertions: Status reloaded from Host seamlessly after reload

S15.name: DSH Process Restart Persistence with Full ECDICT
S15.precondition: ECDICT fully installed and active in first DSH process
S15.action: Kill DSH process, boot new DSH on same home/profile, inspect status and query "apple"

S12.name: Safe Removal & Fixture Rollback
S12.action: Click "移除本地词典", confirm in modal dialog, observe unlinking and query responses

S18.name: Plugin Runtime Disposer & Unload Hygiene
S18.precondition: Settings page active in DSH client
S18.action: Execute runtime disposer, verify global slot release, store disposal, timer cancellation, and reload idempotence
assertions: Disposer unregisters settings section slot cleanly
Store marked disposed and polling timers aborted
Zero duplicate timers or duplicate entries upon reload

S19.name: Error Code Presentation & Security (401, 409, 500, Network Disconnect)
S19.action: Inject 401, 409, 500, and network drop, and verify sanitized error presentation and zero credential leak
assertions: HTTP 401 displays "服务响应异常 (401)" with zero token leakage
HTTP 409 displays "服务响应异常 (409)" with sanitized error presentation
HTTP 500 displays "服务响应异常 (500)" with zero stack trace leakage
Network disconnect displays "网络连接异常"

S20.name: Storage Quarantine UI Presentation & Dangerous Action Gating
S20.precondition: Host reports quarantined: true, canInstall: false, canRemove: false
S20.action: Observe quarantine banner, status badge, action button disabling, verify code-level bypass refusal, and state recovery
assertions: Displays "存储目录已进入隔离保护" banner
Status badge variant shows "存储隔离保护中"
Dangerous action buttons are disabled (canInstall=false, canRemove=false)
Bypass requests refused with HTTP 409 DIRECTORY_QUARANTINED
UI smoothly recovers and re-syncs once quarantine is cleared
